_note: Manual live verification for 1.36.1 (follow-ups to PR #591; issue #592). Run AFTER the release tool is installed (dotnet tool update -g ai-raccoon). The 1.36.1 tool refuses `settings model reset` while the ADR-0076 outbox row is open (exit 25), so rows 11-12 are only executable on 1.36.1. Rows 3-5 are reproducible against the captured evidence bank; row 3 is the exit-24 surface and must run read-only against a COPY — doctor never writes, but the evidence bank must stay pristine. Coverage decisions (R2 F10a): the live-stuck-bank leg is covered by row 3 (a copy is strictly safer than the live bank) and the stale-lease drain case by row 6 (its command greps the 1009 line) — no extra rows. `derived.pr` is filled in at execution time once this task's PR is open.

items.expected-result: On a brand-new data root with no engine configured, `ai-raccoon doctor` prints `memory engine: not configured — run 'ai-raccoon model embedding set local' …` (wording matches `model embedding show`'s FTS5-only state) and `model migration: none open`, and exits 0.
items.command: DR=$(mktemp -d); ai-raccoon --data-root $DR serve --port 43441 & sleep 4; kill %1; ai-raccoon --data-root $DR doctor; echo EXIT=$?; ai-raccoon --data-root $DR settings model embedding show
items.evidence: <paste both outputs; EXIT=0; the two not-configured wordings agree>

items.expected-result: With both engines configured (or the owner's bank once settled), doctor prints the full 11-line report: memory engine + code engine lines adjacent, both pending counts, `model migration: none open`, `status: HEALTHY`, exit 0. The memory and code engine lines make `embedding.model == embedding.codeModel` visible if that is the state.

On a COPY of the captured evidence bank (docs/work/evidence-2026-08-26-stuck-bank/README.md), doctor prints `model migration: open since … (all MCP tool calls are refused until it finishes)`, `status: MIGRATION IN PROGRESS (schema shape is healthy; …)`, exits 24 — and the copy's SHA-256 is unchanged after the run (doctor never writes).
items.anchor: ExitCode.ModelMigrationOpen; DoctorCommands.cs (status switch); evidence README hashes
items.command: mkdir -p /tmp/ev-copy; cp -p <evidence-dir>/memory.db /tmp/ev-copy/memory.db; shasum -a 256 /tmp/ev-copy/memory.db; ai-raccoon --data-root /tmp/ev-copy doctor; echo EXIT=$?; shasum -a 256 /tmp/ev-copy/memory.db

items.expected-result: A bank whose model_migration row has finished_at set (or the owner's live bank once drained) reports HEALTHY and exits 0 — exit 24 must not leak past an open migration.
items.anchor: R1 Ruling 4 (24 only from the Healthy arm, only on a positively-read open row); R2 B3
items.evidence: <paste output; EXIT=0; no MIGRATION IN PROGRESS>

items.command: <copy the evidence bank, DROP INDEX idx_entries_embed_state, run doctor; echo EXIT=$?>

items.expected-result: While a migration drains (serve against the stuck bank or a seeded scratch bank), the server log shows `Embed drain for Memory started under the model migration: <N> row(s) owed` (1008), then 1003-style finish with the row count, and — if the previous holder died with an expired lease — the 1009 warning naming the previous holder.
items.command: ai-raccoon --data-root <stuck-or-seeded-bank> serve --port 43442 2>&1 | grep -E 'Embed drain|model migration|1009' | head -20
items.evidence: <paste the drain log lines with event ids>

items.expected-result: LoggerMessageEventIdTests and the fast lane are green on the released build; `docs/reference/logging-event-ids.md` count is 174 and the 1002-1013 row names EmbedDrainReporter; the how-to sample still matches the report contract (drift gate).

On a bank with an engine configured but real un-embedded rows (or after a real ingest with no engine), doctor's `memory rows pending: N` prints N > 0, and N agrees with an independent read-only COUNT of the entries table's pending rows — the pending count must not be a hardcoded zero (R2 B2 honest-count bar).
items.command: ai-raccoon doctor; echo EXIT=$?; sqlite3 <data-root>/memory.db "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM entries WHERE embed_state = 'pending';"
items.evidence: <paste both counts; they agree and N > 0>

items.expected-result: With the settings table missing or shape-broken, doctor prints `memory engine: unreadable (settings table missing or unreadable)` — not the not-configured remedy (`run 'ai-raccoon model embedding set local' …`): a broken settings table is not a fresh install, so the remedy would be a false one (R1 S6).
items.command: <copy the evidence bank, DROP TABLE settings, run doctor; echo EXIT=$?>
items.evidence: <paste output; the unreadable wording, no not-configured remedy>

items.expected-result: With a corrupted model_migration row (e.g. started_at NULL), doctor prints `model migration: unreadable` and exits 0 — the unreadable arm is not the open arm, so exit 24 must not fire (R1 Ruling 4 Decision D; R2 B3).
items.anchor: DoctorCommands.cs (MigrationRead.Unreadable arm); R1 Ruling 4 Decision D
items.command: <copy the evidence bank, UPDATE model_migration SET started_at = NULL, run doctor; echo EXIT=$?>

items.expected-result: The blank-provider open-migration state cannot be newly created through any supported product surface after 1.36.1: a migration is born only via StartModelMigrationAsync, whose outbox transaction always writes the provider (and refuses a blank one), and `settings model reset` — the only deleter of embedding.provider — is refused while the row is open (exit 25). Raw-SQL-seeded (the same route the automated test uses), the 1.36.1 tool must (a) print the 1012 blank-provider warning at most once per process with no 526 throw-loop, (b) leave finished_at NULL, and (c) refuse `settings model reset` with EXIT=25, deleting nothing. Already-stranded pre-1.36.1 banks still need manual row close — out of scope here (R1 F15).
items.anchor: EntryEmbedderMigrationDrainReportingTests (1012 once-per-process); SqliteMemoryStore.ModelMigration.cs:28 (provider-required birth); SettingsEndpoint.MapDelete guard (#592)
items.command: DR=$(mktemp -d); ai-raccoon --data-root $DR serve --port 43443 > /tmp/blank-provider-serve.log 2>&1 & sleep 4; sqlite3 $DR/memory.db "DELETE FROM settings WHERE key = 'embedding.provider'; INSERT INTO entries(hash, value, project_id, scope, created_at, updated_at, embed_state) VALUES ('bp-1', 'value', 'p', 'project', 0, 0, 'pending'); INSERT INTO model_migration(id, provider, model, base_url, engine, started_at, finished_at) VALUES (1, 'openai', 'text-embedding-3-small', NULL, 'openai', 0, NULL);"; ai-raccoon --data-root $DR settings model reset; echo EXIT=$?; kill %1; sleep 20; grep -c '1012' /tmp/blank-provider-serve.log; grep -c '526' /tmp/blank-provider-serve.log
items.evidence: <paste output; EXIT=25; 1012 count = 1; 526 count = 0; the migration row still has finished_at NULL>

items.expected-result: On a 1.36.1 bank with all six embedding keys set and an open model_migration row carrying an unexpired lease, both `settings model reset` and `settings model embedding reset` exit 25, print the frozen message verbatim on stderr (`ai-raccoon: model reset refused: a model migration is in progress — every MCP tool call is refused until it finishes; nothing was deleted`), and delete nothing. After closing the row (UPDATE model_migration SET finished_at = <now>), the same reset exits 0 and clears all six keys.
items.command: DR=$(mktemp -d); ai-raccoon --data-root $DR serve --port 43444 & sleep 4; sqlite3 $DR/memory.db "INSERT INTO settings(key, value) VALUES ('embedding.provider','openai'),('embedding.model','text-embedding-3-small'),('embedding.baseUrl','https://api.openai.com/v1'),('embedding.engine','openai'),('embedding.apiKey','sk-test'),('embedding.dimensions','1536'); INSERT INTO model_migration(id, provider, model, base_url, engine, started_at, finished_at, lease_owner, lease_expires_at) VALUES (1, 'openai', 'text-embedding-3-small', NULL, 'openai', 0, NULL, 'test-holder', strftime('%s','now') + 3600);"; ai-raccoon --data-root $DR settings model reset; echo EXIT=$?; ai-raccoon --data-root $DR settings model embedding reset; echo EXIT=$?; sqlite3 $DR/memory.db "UPDATE model_migration SET finished_at = strftime('%s','now') WHERE id = 1;"; ai-raccoon --data-root $DR settings model reset; echo EXIT=$?; sqlite3 $DR/memory.db "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM settings WHERE key LIKE 'embedding.%';"; kill %1
items.evidence: <paste output; EXIT=25 with the frozen message on both refused verbs; then EXIT=0; final embedding.% count = 0>
